note: The variants published for each gene, re-read from the papers on 2026-10-20. Only variants a publication names are entries: no tagging site or lead SNP chosen by us. Induced alleles (EMS, TILLING, transposon tagging, CRISPR), candidates a paper itself rejects and variants whose position could not be obtained from the paper are left out. Retired ids (self-picked tags of the first registry): SC0009, SC0017, SC0018, SC0020, SC0021.

fields.role: what the publication says the variant is: causal (shown to cause the trait or the allele phenotype), proposed (proposed as the cause, not tested), allele (one of the changes that define a published allele), associated, lead_snp, marker
fields.status: site (the release has exactly this change), not_a_site (no site at that position), different_allele (sites there, none with the published alleles), structural (a transposon, large indel or copy-number allele), not_locatable (cannot be placed on v5), unreliable (calls in the gene are dominated by heterozygotes), not_annotated (the gene model is missing from the annotation)
fields.mark: computed by tools/build_snpcurate.py: gold = role causal and status site; silver = any other role and status site; white = any other status
fields.published_as: the publication's own name or description of the variant
fields.pos/ref/alt: B73 v5 position and alleles (plus strand, VCF style); start/end for a structural allele
fields.site_gene: the gene whose consequence the record shows when the site is annotated in another gene
fields.expect: het / hom carriers and the Site QC class of a site, checked at build time

entries.label: Promoter SNP at -324

refs.cite: Zhang X, et al. 2019. Nat Commun 10:5608

entries.note: A promoter SNP in linkage with the tin1 splice-site variant. The release has no site at this base; the 1-bp deletion it calls at the neighboring base is carried by lines of the other allele.

entries.label: Wc: tandem Ccd1 array (1 to 23 copies)
entries.published_as: White Cap (Wc) locus; Wc-ref allele (~24 Ccd1 copies)

refs.cite: Tan BC, et al. 2017. Genetics 206:135-150

entries.note: White Cap is a transposon carrying 1 to 23 tandem copies of a 28-kb Ccd1 repeat; on v5 it inserts at chr9:156,675,817-156,675,824, 1.8 Mb from the single B73 Ccd1. A SNP release cannot genotype it or its copy number.

entries.label: Hel1 helitron at the Ccd1r promoter (B73 type)
entries.published_as: Hel1 (5.4 kb helitron) at the Ccd1r transcription start, B73 haplotype

refs.cite: Tan BC, et al. 2017. Genetics 206:135-150

entries.note: A 5.4-kb helitron at the Ccd1r promoter, the B73 state, which the paper links with yellow grain. A SNP release cannot score its absence.

entries.label: Helitron upstream of Ccd1r (Oh43 type)
entries.published_as: OH43 Helitron insertion (OH43 promoter variant of Ccd1r)

refs.cite: Tan BC, et al. 2017. Genetics 206:135-150

entries.note: A different helitron upstream of Ccd1r, found in 11 of 83 lines including Oh43. The paper gives no position.

entries.label: 392-bp insertion in exon 1 (nsf1)
entries.published_as: +392 bp insertion at 939 bp (Indel 5); nsf1/ben1 392-bp insertion

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413
Nordby JN, et al. 2008. Weed Sci 56:376-382

entries.note: A 392-bp insertion near the end of exon 1 that truncates CYP81A9: the nsf1 (ben1) allele of GA209 and W703a. A SNP release cannot genotype it.

entries.label: TGGA insertion (frameshift)

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: A 4-bp frameshift insertion in exon 1 that defines a loss-of-function haplotype. The release has no site for it.

entries.label: 351-bp deletion removing the start codon
entries.published_as: -351 bp deletion in the 5'UTR and exon 1 (Indel 1, -190)

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: A 351-bp deletion removing the end of the 5’ UTR, the start codon and the start of exon 1 (chr5:6,964,766-6,965,116): the JS188 null allele, which fails to complement an EMS null. A SNP release cannot genotype it.

entries.label: 15-bp in-frame deletion (SAAAL)

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: An in-frame 15-bp deletion (codons 10 to 14) found in 15 of 20 nicosulfuron-sensitive lines and no tolerant line. The release has no site for it.

entries.label: G27V

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: Gly27Val marks the common sensitive haplotype (12 of 20 sensitive lines, no tolerant line). The release has no site there.

entries.label: 6-bp in-frame deletion (Ala-Lys)

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: An in-frame 6-bp deletion of one Ala-Lys unit, in one sensitive line; its exact position in the repeat is uncertain. The release has no site for it.

entries.label: V178A

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: Val178Ala, found in two sensitive lines. The release has no site there.

entries.label: C1445T (T482M in v5)

refs.cite: Zhang Y, et al. 2024. Front Plant Sci 15:1443413

entries.note: A SNP in exon 2 on the common sensitive haplotype. The paper calls it an Arg-to-Cys change; on v5 it is Thr482Met. The release has no site there.
